title: White, Blue & Pink Tall Vase
desc: A tall gold-vase centrepiece mixing white delphinium and hydrangea with soft blue poppies and pink ranunculus, trailing fine green strands.

groups.label: Main flowers
groups.blurb: White spikes and blooms carrying the bouquet, accented with blue and pink touches.

items.role: White delphinium spikes lifting the silhouette with tall vertical lines.
Petal-white hydrangea forming the white body of the arrangement.
Soft pink ranunculus adding rounded rose-like blooms.
White pompon mums giving neat round accents through the white field.
Light pink larkspur echoing the delphinium lines in a blush tone.

groups.label: Grasses & trailing greens
groups.blurb: Fine grasses and hanging strands keeping the shape airy and loose.

items.role: Trailing air grass hanging down in fine, soft green strands.
Fountain-like reed grass spraying outwards for airy movement.
Tall foxtail grass adding upright, brush-like lines.
Fine asparagus fern filling the silhouette with delicate green texture.
